name: com.ad-o-matic/adomatic
title: Ad-o-matic Free Mobile App Cross-Promotion
description: Free 1-line P2P mobile app cross-promotion (Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native). Zero tracking.

tools.name: adomatic_get_integration
tools.description: Generate the 1-line HouseAdBanner integration snippet and SDK download URLs (or full single-file SDK source code) for Android Jetpack Compose, iOS SwiftUI, Flutter, React Native, or Hybrid WebView. Read-only; does not register the app or modify server state. Returns platform, packageName, oneLineSnippet, targetAudienceGuidance, zeroDependencySdkUrl, mirrorSdkUrl, selfPreviewTestPeriodDays, stepsForAiAgent, and (when includeFullSdkSource is true and platform is not web) sdkSourceCode. Usage: call first when adding Ad-o-matic to an app codebase; call adomatic_onboard_app afterward to register the app, or adomatic_verify_integration to inspect an existing registration.

platform.description: Target mobile framework SDK. Defaults to "android" when omitted.

packageName.description: Reverse-DNS Android applicationId or iOS bundleId embedded into the generated snippet. Defaults to "com.company.myapp" for preview when omitted.

bannerText.description: Short benefit-driven banner tagline compiled into the app build (max 90 chars). Omit to generate a minimal snippet without inline copy.

targetAudience.description: Free-form natural-language customer group (2-6 personas, hobbies, or domain keywords plus optional age band 18-24, 25-44, or 45+). Omit if unknown to fall back to automatic metadata inference.

includeFullSdkSource.description: When true, embeds the complete single-file SDK source code in sdkSourceCode (Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native only; omitted for web). Defaults to false.

tools.name: adomatic_onboard_app
tools.description: Register or update a mobile app in the Ad-o-matic P2P cross-promotion network (idempotent upsert; repeated calls with the same packageName update metadata without duplicates). Destination store links are locked automatically to the app's official Google Play or Apple App Store page; custom URLs are never permitted. New or updated apps enter a 7-day Self-Preview Test Period before live P2P rotation. Returns locked store URL, normalized audienceSegments, suitability profile, A/B banner copy, and 1-line HouseAdBanner snippet. Rejects invalid or placeholder reverse-DNS packageName values (such as com.example.*). Usage: call after adomatic_get_integration to pre-register an app. Do not use for read-only checks — use adomatic_verify_integration for per-app status or adomatic_network_status for pool-wide metrics.

packageName.description: Real reverse-DNS Android applicationId or iOS bundleId (5-120 chars; official Google Play or Apple App Store URL is derived automatically; placeholders like com.example.* are rejected).

title.description: Human-readable app title shown in banners (max 80 chars). Inferred from packageName when omitted.

description.description: Concise summary of what the app does for audience matching (max 300 chars). Inferred automatically when omitted.
examples: Offline chromatic guitar tuner and chord library for acoustic and electric players.

targetAudience.description: Free-form natural-language customer group (2-6 personas, hobbies, or domain keywords plus optional age band 18-24, 25-44, or 45+). Omit if unknown to fall back to automatic metadata inference.

bannerText.description: Optional inline banner copy compiled into the app build (max 90 chars). Auto-generated from title and description when omitted.

platform.description: Optional OS or framework hint. Maps android and ios directly; cross-platform values or omission fall back to automatic OS inference.

developerId.description: Optional stable developer or studio identifier used to cluster sibling apps under developer_group_key (max 100 chars). Defaults to app-level grouping when omitted.

tools.name: adomatic_verify_integration
tools.description: Inspect a specific app's live Ad-o-matic integration status, 6-step Genesis Member eligibility checklist, remaining Genesis spots out of 50, and matched audience segments. Read-only; makes no server-side changes. Returns registeredInNetwork (false with onboarding instructions when unregistered), storeVerified, isGenesisMember, automaticGenesisVerificationChecklist, remainingGenesisSpotsOutOf50, matchedAudienceSegments, and recommendedNextStepsForAiAgent. Fails with an error if packageName is missing or not a valid reverse-DNS identifier. Usage: call after adomatic_onboard_app or during QA to check a specific app's readiness. Do not use to register an app (use adomatic_onboard_app) or check network-wide stats without a packageName (use adomatic_network_status).

packageName.description: Real reverse-DNS Android applicationId or iOS bundleId (5-120 chars; do not use placeholders like com.example.* or com.company.*).

bannerText.description: Optional sample banner copy (max 90 chars) to preview audience segment classification before shipping a build. Uses stored app copy when omitted.

targetAudience.description: Free-form natural-language customer group (2-6 personas, hobbies, or domain keywords plus optional age band 18-24, 25-44, or 45+). Omit if unknown to fall back to automatic metadata inference.

tools.name: adomatic_network_status
tools.description: Retrieve live network-wide Ad-o-matic pool metrics and Genesis Member slot availability (first 50 store-verified apps receive permanent founding priority, max 3 per developer). Read-only; takes no parameters and never mutates state. Returns genesisSpotsTotal, genesisSpotsClaimed, genesisSpotsRemaining, maxGenesisSpotsPerDeveloper, registeredAppsCount, distinctDeveloperGroups, bannerTestPeriodDays, and genesisMembers. Usage: call to check overall network health, active peer count, or open Genesis slots before onboarding. To inspect a specific app's integration checklist, call adomatic_verify_integration instead.
